body_html:
How to think about it

  • Pythagorean Theorem: a2 + b2 = c2, with c the hypotenuse.
  • Pythagorean triples: 3-4-5, 5-12-13, 8-15-17, 7-24-25 and their multiples.
  • 45°-45°-90°: legs x, hypotenuse x√2.
  • 30°-60°-90°: short leg x, long leg x√3, hypotenuse 2x.

Examples

Example

30°-60°-90° with hypotenuse 14

short leg 7

Answer: long leg 7√3

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding without squaringSquare, add, then take the root.
√2 in a 30°-60°-90° triangleUse √3 and 2.
Short leg opposite 60°The short leg is opposite 30°.

A triangle has side lengths 9, 40 and 43. Is it acute, right, or obtuse?
items.e: Compare the longest side squared with the sum of the other two squared: 43² = 1,849 and 9² + 40² = 1,681. 1,849 > 1,681, so the triangle is obtuse.
